preview.text: India Champions play South Africa Champions in a T20 match at Sharjah Cricket Stadium, where the usual first-innings score in the 82 recorded T20 matches is 153. South Africa Champions won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours calls for up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 30 degrees.

summary.text: INDCH scored 196-8 with Robin Uthappa scoring 77 off 31 balls, while Imran Tahir took 2 for 27. SACH replied with 198-6 as Jean-Paul Duminy made 66 off 34 balls and Piyush Chawla claimed 2 for 28. South Africa Champions won by 4 wkts.
